mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 slip onto the cap and block side groove too easily, risking a spun thrust bearing without an interference fit, and says King technical support told him the 2024 main bearings were out of spec. A warning thread quoting King's own support is the most serious item in the set.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, and the newest post is unchanged at 3 June 2026 where the OP reports his replacement NOS Clevite thrust bearings measured in spec.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread on the BMW board telling builders to measure every King bearing before install, after a standard-marked box was found to contain mixed 0.25 undersize shells. Titled as a warning and aimed at the whole brand, not one part number.
